# STAR LOOP
16 bars of hydrogen from the drop of IMANU’s STAR remix at 133.33 BPM, conducted from a SCORE (iteration 026, `docs/conductor/`). Four audio bands drive the exposure, the camera distance, the softness and the decoherence; the track is not bundled, so this browser says which file it lacks and the envelopes play without it.
